title: What Mutual Aid Platforms 2.0 Is
definition: Mutual Aid Platforms 2.0: next-gen platforms for mutual aid.
description:
Strip Mutual Aid Platforms 2.0 to its essence and you get next-gen platforms for mutual aid. Simple to say, civilizational to build.

The path runs through Post-Scarcity Economy: first aid ledgers understanding, then platform logistics prototypes, then request routing operations at scale. Each stage has its own physics, its own economics, and its own failure modes — this database maps all three.

Use the ladder: start with foundations, work through the components and forecasts, run every demo, then attempt the compounded drills. By the final record you will hold a working mental model of platform hulls, grounded in real research and honest about what remains unknown.

t: Real Research Today: Mutual Aid Platforms 2.0
title: Real Research Today: Mutual Aid Platforms 2.0
definition: Today's documented research behind Mutual Aid Platforms 2.0.
description:
The road to Mutual Aid Platforms 2.0 is already being paved. Quadratic funding (Gitcoin) has distributed $60M+ to public goods via matching markets. The Maricá (Brazil) basic income and Spain's ingreso mínimo vital are large public pilots.

Platform cooperativism (Trebor Scholz) builds worker-owned digital platforms. Together these programs form the aid ledgers foundation that Mutual Aid Platforms 2.0 will build on — the platform logistics results, the request routing methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as platform logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Mutual Aid Platforms 2.0
definition: Estimates Mutual Aid Platforms 2.0 readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Mutual Aid Platforms 2.0 components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a platform hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates Mutual Aid Platforms 2.0 operating for a day.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where aid ledgers monitoring, platform logistics redundancy, or request routing maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Mutual Aid Platforms 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Mutual Aid Platforms 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Mutual Aid Platforms 2.0 — next-gen platforms for mutual aid.

Phase 1 — Prove (aid ledgers): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (platform logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (request routing): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (trust webs): platform hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and communities-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
